rows.label: qst703201_msg0001
rows.name:
Get a grip, I beg you. What's
the use of worrying before
you've even set off?

rows.label: qst703201_msg0002
rows.name:
No, see, that's the worst part...
I thought I'd have the courage
by now, but it's just...

rows.label: qst703201_msg0003
rows.name:
Is something the matter?
You seem troubled.

rows.label: qst703201_msg0004
rows.name: Who're you then...?

rows.label: qst703201_msg0005
rows.name:
...Oh, right, Kaede-chan! Let's ask
these people to help us!

rows.label: qst703201_msg0006
rows.name: Another one of your sudden ideas...

rows.label: qst703201_msg0007
rows.name:
If I could interject... Why don't
you just tell us what's wrong, and
then we'll take it from there, hm?

rows.label: qst703201_msg0008
rows.name:
Ah, I see. So Rita's only
just become a Driver?

rows.label: qst703201_msg0009
rows.name:
That's right! So I've come to
Gula to explore around, hoping
I'd get a bit stronger.

rows.label: qst703201_msg0010
rows.name:
And yet you're asking for help the
moment we arrive.

rows.label: qst703201_msg0011
rows.name:
Is that how little
faith you have in me?

rows.label: qst703201_msg0012
rows.name: N-no! I just...

rows.label: qst703201_msg0013
rows.name:
...How about this? You leave first,
and we'll follow after.

rows.label: qst703201_msg0014
rows.name: So we can step in if things get ropy?

rows.label: qst703201_msg0015
rows.name:
But if it looks like you're managing
on your own strength, we'll leave
well alone. Does that sound good?

rows.label: qst703201_msg0016
rows.name: Hmph. That seems reasonable enough...

rows.label: qst703201_msg0017
rows.name:
Is that really all right?!
Thank you so much!

rows.label: qst703201_msg0018
rows.name: I knew it would turn out like this.

rows.label: qst703201_msg0019
rows.name: Meeting here must be fate.

rows.label: qst703201_msg0020
rows.name:
...Before you go, we should
establish a clear goal. We can't
keep providing aid forever.

rows.label: qst703201_msg0021
rows.name:
For the time being, let's say we'll
head for the Restful Waterside. It's
meant to be somewhere nearby.

rows.label: qst703201_msg0022
rows.name: Kasumi, any ideas?

rows.label: qst703201_msg0023
rows.name:
I have heard before it is somewhere
on the Divine Beast's back... It
shouldn't be far from here.

rows.label: qst703201_msg0024
rows.name:
Alright, then! Let's head for
the Divine Beast's back!

rows.label: qst703201_msg0025
rows.name:
Sorry to drag you into this.
Everyone, we'll see you later...

rows.label: qst703201_msg0026
rows.name: Here I go!
